inputs.sbc_source: none: state-controlled PRC H-share issuer with no share-based payment scheme; cash-flow statements FY2018-FY2025 carry no SBC add-back and EquityAwardTaxes kpi is 0 every year
inputs.share_count_basis: 3,542,393,204 ordinary shares (domestic + H) per Q3-2026 PRC-GAAP balance sheet (30 Sep 2026) and the H1-2026 interim; no dilutive instruments (diluted EPS reported as nil). Held FLAT. The 2024 (+132m) and Mar-2025 (+140m, HK$1.98bn placing) increases were acquisition/placing issuance already in the count. A 20% general mandate exists but is unexercised; not modelled.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T19:26Z). Parity: USDHKD 7.8475 / USDCNY 6.6768 = 1.1753 and 1/HKDCNY 0.8521 = 1.1736, all within 0.3%. No A-share dual listing exists for a direct price parity check. Statements and all flows are RMB (IFRS, HKEX); only the quoted price is HKD. Unsuffixed per-share values are HKD; *_cny twins are the model currency.
inputs.net_debt_basis: 30 Jun 2026 IFRS interim: interest-bearing bank and other borrowings 8,115.250 current + 4,426.190 non-current, corporate bonds 1,999.400 current + 3,998.733 non-current, lease liabilities 46.750 = total debt 18,586.323; less cash and cash equivalents 4,608.753 = net debt 13,977.57. Company's own gearing definition (ex-lease) gives 35.9% at 30 Jun 2026. Subsequent Q3-2026 PRC-GAAP balance sheet (30 Sep 2026) shows ~RMB2.1bn of cash swept into held-for-trading wealth-management products (4,131 vs 2,859) with the combined liquid pool flat, borrowings +~1.0bn and other equity instruments (perpetuals) +1,347 to 6,647; the Q3 perpetual issue and its cash proceeds are both left out so the bridge stays on one balance-sheet date.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. Risk-free: China 10y CGB ~1.8%. Cost of equity ~9.5% = 1.8% + beta 1.1 x (6.0% CNY ERP + 1.0% H-share/SOE governance premium). After-tax cost of debt ~2.0% (bonds and bank loans priced 2.0-3.1%, FY2025 interest paid 521m on ~18.7bn). Market-value weights ~70% equity (3,542m shares at the HKD price / 1.1724 = ~RMB55bn) / 30% debt + perpetuals (~RMB24bn) -> 7.3%, rounded UP to 8.0% to carry the SOE/safety-governance discount once, in the rate. Gold-price cyclicality is NOT in the WACC: it lives in the three scenarios (section 7f, charge risk once). Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities (46.75m, immaterial) sit in total_debt; lease principal (15.9m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows; no lease_cost_pct_path.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: cash_tax_rate_path is a combined tax + NCI leakage rate on EBIT. Calibration FY2025: EBIT ~6,050 (PBT 5,569 + finance costs); cash tax ~22% (FY2025 paid 810 / PBT 5,569 = 14.5%, expense 20.3%; 9M-2026 expense 28.7%; PRC statutory 25%, some western mines at 15%); NCI took 826 of 4,440 group profit = 18.6% of post-tax, ~17% of NOPAT -> 22% + 78% x 17% = 35.3%, used as 35% in Y1, drifting to 37% by Y5 because Ruihai Mining (the largest growth asset, ~30% held outside the group) ramps NCI's share. Check: FY2025 attributable NI 3,614 + after-tax interest ~400 = 4,014 = 66% of EBIT, i.e. 34% leakage. NCI book (4,962m at 30 Jun 2026) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner_fcf_dcf_component, routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' (owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md: currency a1/a2, leases b, NCI c, matching-asset d, SBC-zero e, risk-once f). dcf-methods has no dedicated resource-extraction method; the gold-specific features are handled inside the engine as follows. (1) Reserve depletion: JORC recoverable reserves 521.24 t (16.76 Moz) at 31 Dec 2025 against 19.8 t/yr mine-produced gold = ~26 years, far beyond the 10-year explicit horizon, and 71 t of resources were added by exploration in 2025 alone; so no run-off/depletion schedule is imposed -- instead sustaining-plus-growth capex is held at or above D&A in every year of every scenario (capex 11-13% of revenue vs D&A 9-10%), and the terminal value is capped at a cyclical 14x owner FCF (12x in the bear), not the 18.6x that Gordon at 8%/2.5% would allow. (2) Commodity cycle: revenue is gold price x volume; each scenario carries an explicit RMB/g gold deck (see scenario_narratives) -- base normalises below spot, bull holds spot, bear mean-reverts -- and the WACC is the same in all three. (3) FY0 = FY2025 (revenue 18,055.6; underlying EBITDA ~7,700 = reported 7,869 less ~900 fair-value/investment gains plus 720 PPE impairment, ~42.7% at the FY2025 SGE average of RMB798/g); Y1 = FY2026, discounted a full year per the house end-of-year convention. (4) EBITDA margin paths are on an UNDERLYING basis excluding fair-value and investment gains on the wealth-management/gold-futures book, which is why the matching assets (FVTPL financial assets + term deposits) are in the equity bridge and the FY2025 interest income is stripped from last_fcf. (5) The gold price in the FY2026 YTD (H1 average US$4,689/oz, RMB1,058/g; spot at valuation ~US$4,185/oz = RMB898/g at USDCNY 6.6768) is ~12% above the FY2025 average; base-case revenue growth is nonetheless modest because domestic output is down 12.3% (H1-2026, 12,526 kg total) after two fatal accidents and regulator-ordered suspensions that were still in force at 30 Jun 2026. (6) Perpetual capital instruments (5,393m, IFRS equity) are deducted at carrying value in the bridge; their distributions (~264-319m/yr) are therefore NOT charged in the flows -- debt-like treatment, charged once. (7) House and street coincide (SBC zero): band_position is null by construction. Analysis.json (2026-10-17) read for bull/bear axes.

equity_bridge.item: Perpetual capital instruments at carrying value (deducted; debt-like claim ranking ahead of ordinary shares)
equity_bridge.note: H1-2026 interim, 30 Jun 2026, equity section. Rose to 6,647 at 30 Sep 2026 (PRC GAAP) on a Q3 issue whose cash is equally outside this bridge.

equity_bridge.item: Financial assets at FVTPL (wealth-management products) + term deposits, current and non-current (added; matching asset for the FV/investment gains and interest income excluded from the flows)
equity_bridge.note: H1-2026 interim, 30 Jun 2026: FVTPL 2,074.189 + term deposits 873.000 + 3.457. Pledged deposits (799.2, margin/environmental funds) excluded as restricted.

equity_bridge.item: Group finance-company net position: loans receivable less deposits from customers (deducted)
equity_bridge.note: H1-2026 interim, 30 Jun 2026: loans receivable 1,847.952 + 203.910 = 2,051.862 less deposits from customers 2,870.874 + 300.000 = 3,170.874. Customer deposits jumped 1.9bn in H1-2026 and funded part of the cash build that sits in the net-debt line; counting the cash without its funding liability would overstate equity.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 5-year revenue CAGR FY2025-FY2030 (gold normalised to ~RMB820/g, domestic volume recovered, Ruihai/Abujar/LION growth)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 11.3% diverges >30% from revenue 18.7% and EPS 24.6%: FY2023-FY2025 growth is almost entirely the gold price (SGE Au9999 average +45.5% in 2025 alone), and total equity is inflated by perpetual issuance (1.5bn -> 5.3bn) and NCI (3.5bn -> 4.4bn) plus two share placings. None of the historical CAGRs is a usable forward rate for a commodity producer; the selected rate is the base-case path.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC is zero throughout). The 3-year owner-FCF CAGR is undefined because FY2022 owner FCF was negative (-1,225m, a working-capital/inventory build year). Owner FCF: FY2020 2,251 -> FY2025 3,463 (9.0%/yr) while revenue compounded 18.7% -- capex (1,382 -> 2,899) and inventory absorbed most of the gold windfall.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 FY2026 +3%: 9M-2026 revenue 13,510 (+8.7% yoy) plus a Q4 at roughly 90% of Q4-2025 (spot RMB898/g is ~4% below the Q4-2025 SGE average while domestic volume stays ~10% short) -> ~18.6bn. Y2 FY2027 +6%: suspended Zhaoyuan mines resume (precedent: the 2021 Shandong-wide safety stoppage cut mine output to 12.6 t and FY2022 recovered to 19.2 t) and Abujar/Ruihai add volume (+12-14%), offset by the gold deck normalising from ~RMB900 to ~RMB850/g. Y3-Y5 +5/+4/+3.5%: Ruihai ramp and LION Ltd commissioning on a flat ~RMB820/g deck (+2%/yr nominal thereafter). Y6-Y10 taper to 2.5% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: Underlying EBITDA margin vs SGE gold: FY2023 32% at ~RMB450/g, FY2024 36% at ~RMB548/g, FY2025 ~43% at RMB798/g. Y1 36%: 9M-2026 PRC-GAAP EBIT ex FV/investment items ~3,650 + D&A ~1,230 = ~36% with suspension costs (domestic integrated cost RMB323/g in H1-2026 vs 216/g a year earlier) and a weaker Q3. Y2-Y5 40-41%: unit cost falls back on resumption, ~RMB820/g deck is 3% above the FY2025 average, less two to three years of 3% cost inflation. Y6-Y10 ease to 40% as grades at the mature Zhaoyuan mines decline.
base.capex_rationale: FY2023-25 capex 21%/18%/16% of revenue (1,776/2,060/2,899); 9M-2026 1,367 = ~10% annualised with the Zhaoyuan mines idle. Y2-Y4 13% for Ruihai, Dayingezhuang deep extension, Abujar expansion and LION Ltd; 11% long-run, held above D&A (9.5%) because an underground gold miner that spends less than D&A is shrinking.
base.tax_rationale: Combined cash tax + NCI leakage on EBIT; see inputs.nci_treatment. 35% -> 37% as Ruihai (30% NCI) becomes a larger share of EBIT.

bull.rationale: Gold holds spot (~RMB900/g, ~US$4,200/oz) through 2027 and compounds 2-3%/yr; all suspended mines are back by early 2027 and FY2027 mine output exceeds the FY2025 19.8 t; Ruihai reaches design throughput by 2029 and LION Ltd is commissioned on time. Margin 45-46% = FY2025's 43% at RMB798/g plus the price uplift, less inflation. Same WACC as base: the upside is in the flows, not a cheaper rate.

bear.rationale: Gold mean-reverts to ~RMB650/g (~US$3,000/oz) by FY2027 and grows only 2%/yr nominal; the Zhaoyuan suspensions run into 2027 and the sector-wide inspection regime caps domestic output below FY2025 permanently (a repeat of the 2021 pattern without the 2022 rebound); Ruihai ramps late. Margin 32-33% = between FY2023's 32% at RMB450/g and FY2024's 36% at RMB548/g, after cost inflation and higher safety spend. Capex is NOT cut below 11%: the reserve base still has to be sustained. Terminal cap 12x because a lower-gold world de-rates the sector.

scenario_narratives.base: Gold deck: ~RMB850/g in FY2027 easing to ~RMB820/g (~US$3,800/oz at USDCNY 6.68) from FY2028, +2%/yr nominal after -- about 9% below spot and 3% above the FY2025 average, the midpoint between the two. The two suspended Zhaoyuan mines (fatal accidents Feb and May 2026; still suspended at 30 Jun 2026) resume during 2027 and domestic output returns to the FY2025 level by FY2028; Abujar (Cote d'Ivoire, overseas output +33% in H1-2026, cost US$1,838/oz) and Ruihai (82.6 Mt reserve, initial industrial production reached 2025) carry group mine output to ~23-24 t by FY2030. Underlying EBITDA margin recovers from ~36% (FY2026, suspension costs) to 40-41%. Capex stays above D&A throughout. Combined tax + NCI leakage 35% -> 37%. Terminal value binds at the 14x cap (Gordon at 8%/2.5% = 18.6x).
scenario_narratives.bull: Gold holds at or above spot (~RMB900/g) and compounds; the central-bank bid and a dovish Fed turn keep the 2026 correction shallow. Suspensions lift by early 2027 with no further incidents; FY2027 revenue +12% on a full domestic rebound plus Ruihai and Abujar growth; Ruihai at design capacity by 2029, LION Ltd commissioned. Margin 45-46%. The sell-side targets of HK$41-46 (Citi, Goldman, Macquarie, H1-2026) need roughly this deck AND a re-rating above the 14x cap.
scenario_narratives.bear: Gold mean-reverts to ~RMB650/g (US$3,000/oz) as the Warsh Fed prices hikes and official-sector buying slows. A third safety incident or a prolonged Shandong inspection campaign keeps the Zhaoyuan mines idle into 2027 and caps domestic output structurally below FY2025; the gold-futures/AU(T+D) book records further fair-value losses (9M-2026: -265m). FY2027 revenue -5%, margin ~30-33%. With RMB14.0bn net debt plus 5.4bn perpetuals ahead of ordinary shareholders, equity value is highly geared to this case -- the bear value lands near a quarter of the base: the leverage, not the mine, is what the bear case exposes.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: two fatal accidents in five months with mines still suspended at the balance-sheet date, a tightening national inspection regime that is systemic rather than company-specific, gold within ~10% of an all-time high, a 9M-2026 fair-value loss on the hedging book, and RMB19.4bn of debt and perpetuals ranking ahead of equity. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs gold to hold spot AND a clean 2027 resumption AND Ruihai on schedule, three independent things. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A gold miner is a gold-price deck times a volume path minus a cost base, so the valuation is a judgment about the deck first and the mines second. The house base case deliberately normalises gold below spot (~RMB820/g, ~US$3,800/oz) rather than capitalising a near-record price in perpetuity; the bull case is spot held, which is roughly what the current price already requires. Reserve life (~26 years recoverable, exploration replacing depletion) removes the need for a depletion run-off, so the engine is the standard owner-FCF DCF with sustaining capex held above D&A, a cyclical terminal cap (14x, 12x bear), CNY WACC, perpetuals treated as debt, NCI charged through a leakage rate, and the wealth-management/finance-company book carried in the bridge at book. Every RMB50/g (~6%) on the long-run gold deck is worth roughly RMB1.0-1.1bn of annual EBITDA, i.e. about HK$2.5-3 per share at the base multiples: the deck is the whole argument.
key_risks_to_valuation: Gold price: base deck ~RMB820/g vs spot ~RMB898/g and an H1-2026 average of RMB1,058/g; the market price sits above the house base because it capitalises spot.
Mine suspensions: no resumption date disclosed for the two Zhaoyuan mines; a third incident or a Shandong-wide campaign (2021 precedent cut output 37%) breaks the base-case volume path.
Financial leverage: RMB14.0bn net debt + RMB5.4bn perpetuals (6.6bn after the Q3 issue) against ~RMB55bn market cap; bear-case equity value is roughly a quarter of base.

Hedging/trading book: AU(T+D) and SHFE futures plus RMB2-4bn of wealth-management products produce +872m (9M-2025) / -265m (9M-2026) swings excluded from the underlying margin; a large adverse mark would hit cash via margin calls.

NCI leakage: Ruihai (~30% external) is the growth engine, so the attributable share of incremental EBIT falls; the leakage path assumes 37% by Y5 -- if Ruihai dominates faster, attributable value is lower.
SOE governance and related-party concentrate trades with Shandong Zhaojin Group (renewed to 2027); 20% general share-issue mandate unexercised but live.
FX: HKD per-share values move with CNY/HKD; a 5% RMB depreciation cuts the HKD value ~5% with no change to the RMB model.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range 15.82-42.36 HKD. FX: Yahoo CNYHKD=X at the date in inputs.fx_note, parity-checked against USDHKD/USDCNY.
